system.description: While Manic, you become fundamentally impossible to stop. You gain immunity to the Grappled and Prone conditions as a result of a hostile creatures jutsu. Additionally, while within 10 feet of your Priority target, you can make opportunity attacks against them as a result of moving, or casting a Jutsu with the Hand Sign (HS) or Mobility (M) components.
